summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Lunar Theories
summary.text: Catalog entries 517–529 covering transits in a nativity, diseases, ascendant judgments, human or monstrous births, living or dead nativity charts, dinner preparation, winds, and city sieges. The entries also describe lunar relationships with Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, and Venus across the zodiac, diagrams of the 28 lunar mansions, and stellar conjunctions in one house.
